newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to auction 11.5 trln rbls.
newsitem.headline: Russia to auction 11.5 trln rbls.

text.p: The Russian Finance Ministry will auction 8.50 trillion roubles in six-month GKO discount Treasury bills and 3.00 trillion roubles in a new 679-day tranche of OFZ interest-bearing bonds on December 11, the central bank said on Wednesday.
Full details of the auctions follow:
Full details of the T-bill auction:
NOTE - Although the issue runs for over six months, it is officially classified as six-month paper.
Full details of the new bond tranche:
In roubles terms the coupon equals 106,657 roubles less accruals of 57,430.69 roubles.
The issue closed at 70.13 on Tuesday.
On December 11 the finance ministry will pay 690.90 billion roubles in bond interest (series 24007) and repay 6.47 trillion roubles in maturing six-month T-bills (series 22036).
